lines.t: Verse 1
This world can leave me empty, like something’s missing inside
Surrounded by the noise, but it doesn’t satisfy
But when I turn to You, everything starts to change
That hollow feeling fades, and I don't feel the same
There’s a peace I can’t explain that settles in my soul
In Your presence, I finally feel whole
Chorus
It’s a beautiful feeling
Every time I say Your name
I feel like a new person,
Like I’m not the same
Amidst all the chaos,
You bring me peace again
It’s a beautiful feeling
When I turn to You within
Verse 2
In a world that’s chasing things that don’t last long
I’m finding something steady I can build my life upon
Why would I trade this feeling for fame?
I just wouldn’t feel the same.
What I’ve found in You is worth so much more
It feels like love, truth, peace, that I've never felt before.
Chorus
It’s a beautiful feeling
Every time I say Your name
I feel like a new person,
Like I’m not the same
Amidst all the chaos,
You bring me peace again
It’s a beautiful feeling
When I turn to You within
Bridge
It’s more than happiness that fades with time
It’s a steady kind of joy that lives inside
Nothing else compares, nothing comes close
To this beautiful feeling that comes from You
Final Chorus
It’s a beautiful feeling
Every time I say Your name
I feel like a new person,
Like I’m not the same
Amidst all the chaos,
You bring me peace again
It’s a beautiful feeling
When I turn to You within
